title: results/<run>/<m>/<domain>/fix-report.json (domain: playwright-ui, playwright-api or k6): a fixer's answer to every blocker/major finding of this round (source review: ids '<test id>/<dimension>' with '#<n>' when a dimension has several findings, 'general#<n>', or 'gate#<n>' for a gate finding) or every healable triage row (source triage: the row key). `fix.mjs check` fails unless every finding or row has exactly one entry, a `fixed` entry lists files that really changed this round, and a `not-fixed` entry has one of the four reasons and a text.

files.description: The code files changed for it, relative to the product's Playwright or k6 repo (or the framework root).

text.description: Why, specific to this finding or row (for disagree-with-cited-reason: what in the cited code contradicts the reviewer).

round.description: The review round (source review) or heal round (source triage) in the fixer's prompt.
